name: io.github.andreymudri/vault-mcp
description: Long-term memory for a coding agent: searches your Obsidian vault and cites path:line.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the root folder of the Obsidian vault to serve. Required; the server exits with a message on stderr without it.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language the server speaks in tool descriptions and errors: 'en' (default) or 'pt'. It never changes what is written into the vault — commit subjects and section names follow the vault.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_AUTO_PUSH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to git push after each write's commit. Off by default: it is the only thing this server does that leaves the machine. A failed push is reported as a warning, never rolled back.
